subdials._comment: Scales the SOLVED shared sub-dial radius (small seconds + reserve). Applied in solveLayout, so it needs a reload; the §25 C boot assert still guards the wells against the central setting wheel, so an oversized factor warns rather than silently colliding. Position is solved layout and is deliberately NOT a knob. BOUNDS: max 1.0 because the solved radius already sits exactly on the §25 C ceiling (well ring vs central setting wheel) — measured: factor 1.15 penetrates by 1.33; min 0.5 because below half size the wells swallow their own hands.

ribbing._comment: Glashuette stripes on the 3/4 plate + escape bridge. widthUnits = band pitch in model units; angleDeg = direction the bands PROGRESS in (stripes run perpendicular); tilt = normal scallop strength (0 = off). Stripes are computed from WORLD position in the shader, so they continue across separate parts by construction.

perlage._comment: Circular graining on the BASE plate, stamped like the real thing: pearls in a staggered grid, each fragment shaded by the LAST pearl (row-major application order) whose radius covers it — so every pearl overlaps its neighbours in one direction, shingled. pearlRadiusUnits > pitch/2 sets the overlap.

ruby._comment: Bearing jewels, pallet stones, impulse pin. Read at material creation and updatable live; the advanced panel writes here.
